notes.title: Uncover the Mystery: A Haunting Surprise Awaits!
notes.content:
[h1]Dare to face the dark?[/h1] 

The Devil’s Bride invites you to uncover the horrifying tale of a cursed wedding. Don’t quit just yet, the terrifying ending is waiting for you. Play now and find out!


[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/vx0WzzG/1.png[/img]

[b]Gameplay Improvement[/b]
We’re excited to share that we’ve successfully addressed and resolved a critical bug that some players were experiencing. Here’s what we’ve fixed and improved:

[list]
[*] [b]Item Stuck Bug Fixed[/b]
[/list]
We’ve fixed the problem where your items would get stuck when you die. Now, your items will work as they should and stay accessible as you play through the game

[list]
[*] [b]Improved Game Flow[/b] 
[/list]
We know how important it is to have a smooth experience in The Devil's Bride especially when you’re immersed in the eerie atmosphere. With this fix, you can continue your journey into darkness without any interruptions or glitches

[list]
[*] [b]Enhanced Immersion[/b]
[/list]
Focus fully on the creepy story, scary environments, and terrifying moments. We’ve made sure the game plays smoother, so you can enjoy the haunting world of The Devil's Bride without any problems.


[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/tYxsXr8/2.png[/img]

We’ve been paying attention to your feedback and have worked hard to make the game better. Our team is dedicated to making sure you have the best experience possible, and we’ll keep improving the game.

Thank you for your patience while we fixed everything! Now, dive back into Pengantin Iblis and experience the terrifying story without any issues.

notes.title: The Devil's Bride Ritual Refinement - Polished Gameplay and Bug Fixes
notes.content:
[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/cx301VX/Untitled-design-2.gif[/img]

[h1]Key Features of the Update[/h1]

[b]Improved Movement Mechanics[/b]
[*] We've made character movements smoother and more responsive, so it feels more natural when you control them.
[*] The game now reacts better to your actions, with more fluid transitions and faster responses during exploration.
[*] Fixed issues where characters would sometimes get stuck or experience delays, ensuring a smoother gameplay experience.
[/olist]

[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/tYRVFWP/Untitled-design-5.gif[/img]

[b]Enhanced Interaction System[/b]
[*] Interacting with objects in the game is now more seamless. When you approach an item, it's easier to understand what you can do with it.
[*] We’ve improved the way you interact with items, making sure they respond correctly when you try to pick them up, examine, or use them.
[*] Added visual cues, so you'll clearly know when something is interactive, helping you stay immersed in the game world.
[/olist]

[img]https://i.ibb.co.com/LJKBQNS/Untitled-design-6.gif[/img]


[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[*] Fixed issues with character animations that caused movements to feel unnatural or too sudden. Now, your character moves more fluidly without any awkward stutters.
[*] We’ve resolved problems where certain objects didn’t work properly or behaved inconsistently, ensuring that everything in the game responds the way it should.
[*] Many smaller bugs were also addressed, making sure your experience is as smooth and enjoyable as possible.
